Messages.Author: Pascek
Messages.Body:
Hello guys,

Just to clarify, the blood is paid by the acting during his untap phase or during the untap phase of the minion with the card?

Thanks!

Roberto Mautone Jr.
Praetor

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
Name: Unburdening the Bestial Soul

[BL:R1, LoB:R]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Obeah Animalism
[ani] +1 stealth action. Move 1 or more blood from this vampire to any other vampire.
[obe] As [ani] above, and untap this acting vampire.
[OBE]  Put this card on an ally or a younger vampire. The minion with this card cannot take actions, block or play reaction cards. During this minion's untap phase, this card is burned unless this acting vampire burns 2 blood.

Card text says that it happens during the untap phase of the controller of the minion with the card.

You can compare it to for example to Consignment to Duat:

Name: Consignment to Duat

[BH:C, KMW:PB2]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Serpentis
[ser]  Steal 1 blood or life from a ready minion.
[SER]  Put this card on a ready minion. During this minion's untap phase, he or she burns 1 blood or life. If this vampire cannot burn a blood, he or she goes to torpor. Burn this card if this acting minion enters combat or leaves the ready region. A minion can have only one Consignment to Duat.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Unburdening the Bestial Soul
Type: Action
Requires: Obeah/Animalism
[ani] +1 stealth action. Move 1 or more blood from this vampire to any other vampire.
[obe] As [ani] above, and untap this acting vampire.
[OBE]  Put this card on an ally or a younger vampire. The minion with this card cannot take actions, block or play reaction cards. During this minion's untap phase, this card is burned unless this acting vampire burns 2 blood.

Vamp A plays Unburdening the Bestial Soul on Vamp B. When Vamp B's untap phase happens, Unburdening the Bestial Soul is burned unless Vamp A burns 2 blood.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Juggernaut1981 wrote:
> Unburdening the Bestial Soul
> Type: Action
> Requires: Obeah/Animalism
> [ani] +1 stealth action. Move 1 or more blood from this vampire to any other vampire.
> [obe] As [ani] above, and untap this acting vampire.
> [OBE]  Put this card on an ally or a younger vampire. The minion with this card cannot take actions, block or play reaction cards. During this minion's untap phase, this card is burned unless this acting vampire burns 2 blood.
>
> Vamp A plays Unburdening the Bestial Soul on Vamp B. When Vamp B's untap phase happens, Unburdening the Bestial Soul is burned unless Vamp A burns 2 blood.
>
Correct.

"This minion" always refers to the minion the card is on.
Otherwise, the wording would be "the acting minion" (as it is later on this one), or "the chosen minion" (Dirty Contract), or something in the lines of "the first minion", when several minions are chosen (Toreador Grand Ball)
